digest.component_or_area: CI test infrastructure - real-time window optimization
propositions: Test-only real-time windows in review-bot bootstrap (~10.15s), lock-retry (~15.56s), shutdown (~9s), and autodeploy (~11.25s combined) exceed useful coverage and must be shortened without altering production timeout/retry/drain/health budgets.
Shortening must preserve real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary behavior via behavioral contract cards (attempt counts, backoff schedules, terminal states, cleanup, observability).
Clock injection and window scaling are test-owned only; production configuration and defaults remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Implementation achieved 47.9% focused-suite wall reduction (56.22s to 29.31s median, clearing 20s aggregate bar) with each modified family clearing 50% individually.
Exact-defect mutations (disabled retries, fresh drain without in-flight gate, episode reset plus unknown-as-busy) remained RED after shortening, confirming behavioral preservation.
Merged Gerrit 1824 patchset 2 with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; CI passed with zero blocking advisories after DOWN_UNTIL_DEPLOY ordinal-stub remediation.
